summary: Implementation plan complete for task 116. Plan at specs/116_core_agent_system_consolidation/plans/01_orchestrate-centric-consolidation.md: 10 fully-sequential phases, ~15 hours, treating this as a meta-task whose deliverables are documents plus backlog state, never edits to agent-system/extensions/** or .claude/**.
